note: Resolved per-room sensors, the floor/household and power aggregates derived from them, the climate health-risk binary sensor, and the low-battery helper. Reference only; entity ids are anonymised. NOTE on 'Any battery low': its threshold is duplicated in the dashboard card that renders the list -- the helper decides whether the card is visible, the card decides what goes in it. Change both together or the card appears saying '0 low batteries'.

options.name: Any battery low
options.state: {{ states.sensor | selectattr('attributes.device_class','defined') | selectattr('attributes.device_class','eq','battery') | rejectattr('entity_id','search','volvo') | rejectattr('state','in',['unknown','unavailable']) | map(attribute='state') | map('float', 101) | select('lt', 15) | list | count > 0 }}

options.name: Climate health risk
options.state: {% set ns = namespace(risk=false) %}{% for r in ['living_room','office','bedroom','kid1','kid2'] %}{% set t = states('sensor.climate_temp_' ~ r) | float(-99) %}{% set h = states('sensor.climate_humidity_' ~ r) | float(-1) %}{% set c = states('sensor.climate_co2_' ~ r) | float(-1) %}{% if t > -90 and h >= 0 %}{% if h >= 65 or h < 30 or t < 16 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{% set g = (17.27 * t / (237.7 + t)) + log(h / 100) %}{% set dp = 237.7 * g / (17.27 - g) %}{% if (t - dp) < 3 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% if c >= 1400 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if states('sensor.outside_openweathermap_air_quality_index') | int(0) >= 4 %}{% set ns.risk = true %}{% endif %}{{ ns.risk }}
